tasks.title: Markdown body safety guard
tasks.end_state: A zero-dependency rehype plugin (src/lib/markdown-safety.ts) is registered in astro.config.mjs via markdown.rehypePlugins. It throws at build time on raw hast nodes and on a[href]/img[src]/* with javascript: or data: protocols. allowDangerousHtml stays default true (NOT false, which silently strips). assertMarkdownRendered(entry) requires entry.rendered.html to be a string, making Astro's swallowed glob-render errors fatal. The production-chain fixture (tests/fixtures/markdown-safety/) copies to a temp root, builds via --config ../../../astro.config.mjs (root production config), and proves unsafe Markdown fails + safe Markdown builds. Unit tests cover each violation class and safe controls. No new dependencies. No public Markdown route ships in C1.
tasks.files_note: Declared 5-file cohesive exception: the safety guard is one cohesive unit — the plugin, its production registration, its fixture (unsafe content + probe consumer), and the unit+production-chain test. Approved by the user during /plan.

tasks.title: Dynamic content route and About activation
tasks.end_state: src/pages/[page].astro uses getStaticPaths() constrained through PAGES + resolveRoutes (unknown public records produce no route). It calls assertMarkdownRendered() on every entry before filtering, calls getCollection('pages'), resolveRoutes, joins back through PAGES, validates one-segment path, returns {params:{page},props:{entry,route}}, renders Content in BaseLayout with canonicalPath={route.path} and noindex={route.visibility==='noindex'}. Two microcycles: (1) ship about.md noindex and prove the real dynamic route + noindex meta + sitemap exclusion + nav; (2) promote about.md to public and update all inherited manifests atomically. A permanent copied-production noindex variant is retained in the final suite. Verifier CLI manifest adds /about/ to expectedHtmlRoutes and expectedDiscoverableRoutes, allowEmptySitemap:false. Inherited B1/B2/B3 shell tests updated atomically. No Contact, no Home record, no SiteHeader/sitemap/index/404 changes.
